Free UK delivery on every order, anywhere in the UK.

Return requests are accepted within 7–14 days of receiving your order, depending on local consumer law. Items must be unused, unwashed and in their original packaging. For hygiene reasons, bedding that has been used or washed can’t be returned unless it’s faulty.

Damaged, faulty or not what you ordered? Tell us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo and we’ll arrange a replacement or refund at no cost to you.
